results.title_of_work: In Memoriam of Teilhard de Chardin
results.artistprojectstatement: “The most obvious symbolism was conjured up by the grid – incarceration, imprisonment or a barred way. The sphere in the middle symbolizes the eternal mystery. The two openings on the one side of the piece stand for the two sciences through which he (de Chardin) sought to shed light on this mystery. The grid states our access is barred, and/or, we ought not to touch it until we are mature enough. The whole concept could be applied to the exploration of the atom…”
results.descriptionofwork: Abstract form; Part of the 1975 Symposium;
